data.cultural_impact: The name Kaleena has elements borrowed from both Greek and Hebrew cultures. In the Greek culture, the word “Kaleidos” is derived and it means 'beautiful'; in Hebrew, however, the name “Ela” which means 'God' is used. The combination of these two cultures helps to emphasize Greek and Hebrew cultural influences on this name. One often finds parents choosing this name for their child as it has a unique and beautiful meaning drawn from two diverse sources.
data.spiritual_significance: As a Christian name, Kaleena brings to mind biblical imagery and spiritual meaning. Kaleena signifies a pure, godly being, containing the qualities of goddess and God in one name. In the scripture, Psalm 33:12 says, "Blessed is the nation whose God is the LORD, the people whom He hath chosen for His own inheritance." With “Kaleena,” parents can hope that their child will embody the godly qualities and choose the path that is divinely inspired. As the name signifies a divine feminine with features of both the goddess and God, it amounts to an inspiring name with deep spiritual significance.
